title: Responses, Physiological and Molecular Mechanisms, and Mitigation Strategies of Grapevine Under Salt Stress.
authors: Zheng, Ting; Li, Hongying; Wei, Lingzhu; Xiang, Jiang; Cheng, Jianhui
one_liner_zh: 综述葡萄盐胁迫的生理与分子响应及缓解策略，仅提及转录因子家族，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Soil salinization has become a major global abiotic threat restricting sustainable viticulture, especially in coastal and inland saline-alkali zones. Unlike cereal crops mainly suffering from sodium toxicity, grapevine (Vitis vinifera L.) is a typical chloride-sensitive woody perennial, subjected to superimposed damages of osmotic stress, ionic imbalance and secondary oxidative injury under saline conditions which severely suppress vegetative growth and degrade berry quality. This review systematically summarizes the multi-layered physiological adaptive mechanisms of grapevine against salt stress, including ion homeostasis maintained by salt overly sensitive (SOS), Na(+)/H(+) exchanger (NHX) and chloride channel (CLC) transporter families, active accumulation of osmoprotectants, synergistic enzymatic and non-enzymatic antioxidant systems, and phytohormone crosstalk networks formed by endogenous phytohormones (abscisic acid, ABA; jasmonic acid, JA; salicylic acid, SA; brassinosteroid, BR) and small signaling molecules. We further elaborate comprehensive molecular regulatory cascades governing salt tolerance, covering core functional genes for ion transport, master transcription factor families WRKY, MYB, APETALA2/Ethylene Response Factor (AP2/ERF), NAC, basic helix-loop-helix (bHLH) and emerging epigenetic regulatory layers mediated by deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) methylation, microRNAs (miRNAs), long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) and circular RNAs (circRNAs). In addition, we integrate four categories of field mitigation strategies for saline vineyards: germplasm improvement via salt-tolerant rootstock grafting, rhizosphere soil basal amendment, exogenous biostimulant regulation, and precision agronomic optimization. Current experimental systems do not fully recapitulate complex field combined-stress conditions, as most studies rely on laboratory single-salt stress simulation. Meanwhile, multi-omics, Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats (CRISPR) gene editing and high-throughput phenotyping tools provide promising approaches to deepen our understanding of grape salt tolerance. This review constructs a comprehensive theoretical framework linking physiological responses, molecular regulatory networks and practical field technologies, offering systematic theoretical references and technical guidance for salt-tolerant germplasm innovation and environmentally sustainable viticulture on saline soils.
abstract_zh: 土壤盐渍化已成为制约葡萄产业可持续发展的全球性重大非生物胁迫，尤其在沿海及内陆盐碱地区。与主要遭受钠离子毒害的谷类作物不同，葡萄（*Vitis vinifera* L.）是典型的氯敏感多年生木本植物，在盐碱条件下承受渗透胁迫、离子失衡及继发性氧化损伤的叠加危害，严重抑制营养生长并降低浆果品质。本综述系统总结了葡萄应对盐胁迫的多层次生理适应机制，包括由盐过度敏感（SOS）、Na(+)/H(+)交换体（NHX）和氯离子通道（CLC）转运蛋白家族维持的离子稳态、渗透保护物质的主动积累、酶促与非酶促抗氧化系统的协同作用，以及由内源植物激素（脱落酸，ABA；茉莉酸，JA；水杨酸，SA；油菜素内酯，BR）和小信号分子形成的激素串扰网络。我们进一步阐述了调控耐盐性的综合分子调控级联，涵盖离子转运核心功能基因、主要转录因子家族WRKY、MYB、APETALA2/乙烯响应因子（AP2/ERF）、NAC、碱性螺旋-环-螺旋（bHLH），以及由脱氧核糖核酸（DNA）甲基化、微小RNA（miRNAs）、长链非编码RNA（lncRNAs）和环状RNA（circRNAs）介导的新兴表观遗传调控层。此外，我们整合了盐碱葡萄园的四类田间缓解策略：通过耐盐砧木嫁接进行种质改良、根际土壤基础改良、外源生物刺激素调控及精准农艺优化。当前实验体系未能完全再现田间复杂复合胁迫条件，因多数研究依赖实验室单一盐胁迫模拟。同时，多组学、成簇规律间隔短回文重复序列（CRISPR）基因编辑和高通量表型分析工具为深化我们对葡萄耐盐性的理解提供了有前景的途径。本综述构建了连接生理响应、分子调控网络及实际田间技术的综合理论框架，为耐盐种质创新和盐碱土壤上环境可持续葡萄栽培提供系统的理论参考和技术指导。
